reorderColumnsHint: Usa las flechas para reordenar; usa los interruptores para mostrar u ocultar columnas.
tankedSkillColumns: Columnas de daño recibido (Detalles de habilidad)
abbreviatedDecimalPlacesDescription: Set how many decimal places abbreviated DPS/HPS/TPS values keep in player and skill tables
relativeToTopDPSPlayerDescription: Scale color bars relative to the top DPS player instead of all players. Useful for 20-player groups or world bosses.
relativeToTopDPSSkillDescription: Scale color bars relative to the top DPS skill instead of all skills. Useful for 20-player groups or world bosses.
relativeToTopHealPlayerDescription: Scale color bars relative to the top heal player instead of all players. Useful for 20-player groups or world bosses.
relativeToTopHealSkillDescription: Scale color bars relative to the top heal skill instead of all skills. Useful for 20-player groups or world bosses.
relativeToTopTankedPlayerDescription: Scale color bars relative to the top tanked player instead of all players. Useful for 20-player groups or world bosses.
relativeToTopTankedSkillDescription: Scale color bars relative to the top tanked skill instead of all skills. Useful for 20-player groups or world bosses.
shortenAbilityScoreDescription: Display ability score in abbreviated form
showOthersName.option.name: Mostrar Others' Name
showOthersNameDescription: "Mostrar Others' Class" replaces others' names with their class; "Name - Class/Spec" shows both.
showYourName.option.name: Mostrar Your Name
showYourNameDescription: "Mostrar Your Class" replaces your name with your class; "Name - Class/Spec" shows both.
showPlayerImagineBadgesDescription: Muestra las insignias de Battle Imagine equipadas junto a los iconos de clase.
showOceanWeaponBadgeDescription: Muestra la insignia de arma oceanica antes de los nombres de jugador cuando se detecte.
historyGraphBucketSecondsDescription: Controla cuantos datos de la linea de tiempo se agrupan en cada punto del grafico. Valores pequenos muestran picos mas claros; valores grandes suavizan el ruido. Predeterminado: 5 s.
historyGraphWindowSecondsDescription: Controla la ventana movil usada por el grafico de media movil. Valores pequenos reaccionan mas rapido; valores grandes suavizan rafagas largas. Predeterminado: 15 s.
summaryFieldsDescription: Elige que estadisticas aparecen en el panel de resumen del historial.
summaryField.encounterTime.label: Tiempo del encuentro
summaryField.encounterTime.description: Muestra la duracion completa del encuentro en el resumen.
summaryField.trueDpsTime.label: Tiempo de DPS real
summaryField.trueDpsTime.description: Muestra el tiempo de combate activo usado para calcular el DPS real.
